comparison.objective: Use a platform edge as a pivot to push a heavy carton up a step while keeping it upright; the candidate calibrates a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load tilting, edge engagement, pushing, and balance control versus small-scale coaxial tool seating and counter-torque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires staged or complete stable carton support on the platform without excessive tilt; candidate requires angular calibration, locked nuts, cycling, and clearance.
comparison.reason: No meaningful mechanism or outcome overlap exists.
